name: Notion to Pinecone Vector Store Integration
description: Integrates Notion with Pinecone, allowing Notion pages to be converted into vector embeddings and stored in Pinecone for advanced search and retrieval.

setupVars.label: Pinecone index host (create the index with integrated embedding and field map text=text)

source.path: Notion/Notion to Pinecone Vector Store Integration.json
source.n8nName: Prod: Notion to Vector Store - Dimension 768

blockers.detail: webhook trigger notion/NOTION_PAGE_ADDED_TO_DATABASE needs webhookEndpointId, connectedAccountId

setup: "Notion - Page Added Trigger": after import, register the notion webhook (`cdecli webhook endpoint create -c notion`, then `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug NOTION_PAGE_ADDED_TO_DATABASE`) and set webhookEndpointId, connectedAccountId on the trigger node.
Setup value pineconeNamespace: Pinecone namespace for this collection (for example documents). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.

Setup value pineconeIndexHost: Pinecone index host (create the index with integrated embedding and field map text=text) (for example my-index-abc123.svc.aped-4627-b74a.pinecone.io). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.

hints: "Notion - Page Added Trigger" is a provider webhook (notion/NOTION_PAGE_ADDED_TO_DATABASE). Create the endpoint and trigger instance, then paste the we_… id and connected account into this node before the first run: `cdecli webhook endpoint create -c notion --client-id <id>`, `cdecli webhook endpoint set-data <we_id> --signing-secret <secret>`, `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug NOTION_PAGE_ADDED_TO_DATABASE --account <connectedAccountId>`.
"Pinecone Vector Store" folded a document (documentDefaultDataLoader); retrieved text is expected on the upstream payload as context/documents.

"Pinecone Vector Store" (vectorStorePinecone.insert): The original used a Pinecone index with a separate embeddings node; here the default vector store is a Pinecone index with integrated embedding (upsert records), so Pinecone embeds the text itself.

"Pinecone Vector Store": create a Pinecone index with integrated embedding (for example llama-text-embed-v2, field map text=text) and set pineconeIndexHost; the store uses the namespace "{{pineconeNamespace}}".
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect notion: `cdecli credential create -n "notion" -p notion --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect pinecone: `cdecli credential create -n "pinecone" -p pinecone --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
